info.title: PDF Extractor Skill
info.description: Extract text from a PDF in Firefox and save to a file via Notepad.

firefox_pdf.open: Win+R → firefox → Enter. Then Ctrl+L → type URL → Enter.
firefox_pdf.search: Ctrl+F → type search term → Enter. F3 for next match.
firefox_pdf.text_selection: Triple-click selects a paragraph. If copy fails, read from screenshot and type manually.

notepad.open: Win+R → notepad → Enter. Opens instantly, no wizard.
notepad.save: Ctrl+S → in filename field Ctrl+A → type: aws-bedrock-overview → Enter. Save location doesn't matter.

common_issues.unexpected_dialogs: Press Escape or Alt+F4 to dismiss any unexpected dialog or wizard.
common_issues.pdf_links_activating: Hyperlinks in PDFs activate on click. Use keyboard navigation (F3) instead of clicking text.
common_issues.clipboard_empty: PDF copy often fails. Read text from screenshot and type it with type_text.
